name: Customer Service Agent
rulesText: First time you play a Ticket card each turn while this is on the field, this gains +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Sure, I can take a look at that.

name: Call Center Agent
rulesText: After you play your second Call card each turn, gain 1 Capacity. Once per turn.
flavorText: Your call is very important to someone.

name: Ticket Specialist
rulesText: The first time a Ticket card causes an Employee to return from your Archive each turn, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Closed? According to whom?

name: Escalation Specialist
rulesText: If you activated an Incident during your opponent’s last turn, this gets +1 Power during your next Battle Phase.
flavorText: I understand. Let me escalate this.
implementationNotes: Implemented in v1.4 through generic engine primitives.

name: Customer Advocate
rulesText: Once per turn, when another Customer Service Employee you control is targeted by an attack or opponent effect, redirect it to this Employee if legal.
flavorText: I’ll handle this one.

name: Team Lead Customer Service
rulesText: Promotion 1 — Customer Service. Other Customer Service Employees you control get +1 Power during your opponent’s turn.
flavorText: Who approved this?

name: Head of Customer Service
rulesText: Promotion 2 — Customer Service. The first time a Ticket returns an Employee from your Archive each turn, restore 1 Reputation. Whenever you restore Reputation through a Review card, restore 1 additional.
flavorText: Let’s turn this into a learning opportunity.

name: Ticket Reopened
rulesText: Target 1 Customer Service Staff Employee in your Archive; return it to the field in Onboarding. At the end of your next turn, Archive it.
flavorText: The customer has replied.

name: Escalated Ticket
rulesText: Target 1 Staff Employee in your Archive; return it to the field in Onboarding. Until end of turn, it counts as 2 Employees when used for Promotion. Archive it at end of turn if it is still on the field.
flavorText: Management has been added to the thread.

name: Please Hold
rulesText: When an opponent’s Employee declares an attack: end that attack.
flavorText: Your estimated wait time is…

name: Call Dodged
rulesText: When a Customer Service Employee you control is targeted by an attack, redirect that attack to another legal Employee.
flavorText: Sorry, I was in another call.

name: Wrong Department
rulesText: When an opponent’s targeted Action or effect targets your Employee, redirect it to another legal Employee on the field.
flavorText: I’m afraid you’ve reached the wrong department.

name: Review Portal
rulesText: The first time you restore Reputation each turn, restore 1 additional Reputation.
flavorText: Would you mind rating your experience?

name: Five-Star Review
rulesText: Restore 3 Reputation. If you control a Review System, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Very helpful… Five stars.

name: Complaint by Fax
rulesText: When your opponent activates an Action, delay it until the start of their next Main Phase.
flavorText: Please send the request again. By fax.

name: I'd Like to Speak to Your Manager
rulesText: Search your Deck for a Customer Service Lead or Executive Employee and add it to your hand. If a Customer Service Employee was destroyed by your opponent last turn, your next Customer Service Promotion this turn requires 1 fewer Employee, minimum 1.
flavorText: I’d like to speak to your manager.
implementationNotes: Search and conditional next-Promotion reduction are both implemented.

name: Follow-Up Email
rulesText: Target 1 Ticket Action in your Archive, except Follow-Up Email; return it to your hand. You cannot play that card this turn.
flavorText: Just circling back on the below.

name: Out of Office
rulesText: When an opponent’s targeted Action or effect targets a Customer Service Employee you control, return that Employee to your hand.
flavorText: I will have limited access to my inbox.

name: Ticket Backlog
rulesText: The first Ticket Incident you set each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Current queue: yes.

name: Customer Satisfaction Survey
rulesText: The first time you restore Reputation with a Review card each turn, target Customer Service Employee gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Please rate how delighted you are.

name: Triage Agent
flavorText: Which queue does this belong in?

name: Warm Transfer
rulesText: Target 1 Customer Service Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until end of turn. If it has both Ticket and Call, it gets +2 Power instead.
flavorText: I have just the person for you.

name: IT Service Agent
rulesText: The first Ticket card you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Have you opened a ticket?

name: Service Desk Lead
rulesText: Promotion 1 — IT Service. Once per turn when you play a Ticket card, target opposing Employee gets -1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: If it isn’t in the queue, it doesn’t exist.

name: System Administrator
rulesText: The first IT System you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: I have root access and no patience.

name: DevOps Engineer
rulesText: The first time you play a System through Deploy each turn, gain 1 Capacity.
flavorText: It passed the pipeline.

name: Frontend Developer
rulesText: When you play a Deploy card, this gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: The button is working. On Chrome.

name: ERP Specialist
rulesText: Legacy Systems you play cost 1 less.
flavorText: Nobody touch it. It still runs.

name: Head of IT
rulesText: Promotion 2 — IT. The first IT System you play each turn costs 1 less. Other IT Employees you control get +1 Power while you control at least 2 IT Systems.
flavorText: We need a ticket for that.

name: First Coffee
rulesText: Target 1 IT Employee you control and 1 opposing Employee. Your IT Employee gets +1 Power and the opposing Employee gets -1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Now we can troubleshoot.

name: Ticket Closed
rulesText: Target 1 Ticket Action in your Archive; shuffle it into your Deck, then draw 1 card.
flavorText: Resolved. Please do not reply.

name: Have You Tried Turning It Off and On Again?
rulesText: Target 1 Employee or System; remove its temporary Power changes and temporary effects.
flavorText: No, seriously.

name: Friday Deployment
rulesText: Play an IT System with printed cost 4 or less from your hand without paying its Capacity cost. It counts as played through Deploy. If it leaves the field before the start of your next turn, lose 3 Reputation.
flavorText: What could possibly go wrong before the weekend?

name: Emergency Patch
rulesText: When an IT Employee or System you control would be destroyed by an opponent’s Action or effect, it is not destroyed. This does not negate the rest of that effect.
flavorText: Deploying the fix for the fix.

name: Works on My Machine
rulesText: When an opponent’s targeted Action or effect targets an IT Employee or System you control: negate that effect.
flavorText: Works on my machine.

name: Server Cluster
rulesText: Once per turn during your Main Phase, if you control an IT Employee, gain 1 Capacity.
flavorText: We call it redundancy. Finance calls it expensive.

name: Legacy ERP
rulesText: The first IT Action you play each turn costs 1 less. While this is active, you cannot play more than 2 Actions per turn.
implementationNotes: First IT Action discount and two-Action-per-turn cap are implemented.
flavorText: Migration is planned for Q4. Which year?

name: Backend Developer
rulesText: Once per turn after you play a Deploy card, draw 1 card, then Archive 1 card from your hand.
flavorText: It’s a frontend issue.

name: Hotfix
rulesText: Target 1 IT System you control. The first time it would be destroyed by an opponent’s Action or effect before your next turn, it is not destroyed.
flavorText: Small fix. Very small.

name: Priority: Critical
rulesText: Search your Deck for an IT Service Employee or any Ticket card and add it to your hand.
flavorText: Everything is priority critical.

name: Staging Environment
rulesText: Once per turn during your Main Phase, play an IT System with printed cost 2 or less from your hand for 1 less Capacity. It counts as played through Deploy.
flavorText: Basically production, but with less panic.

name: Rollback Plan
rulesText: Target 1 IT System in your Archive; return it to your hand. You cannot play that card this turn.
flavorText: Good news: we kept the previous version.

name: Administrative Assistant
rulesText: The first time you play an Email or Analog card each turn, this gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: It’s already on your desk.

name: Executive Assistant
rulesText: The first time you play a Lead or Executive each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and one on the bottom.
flavorText: I moved three meetings to make this meeting possible.

name: Office Manager
rulesText: The first time you play a Meeting card each turn, target another Office Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until the start of your next turn.
flavorText: Who booked this room?

name: Process Manager
rulesText: The first Process card you play or set each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: There’s a process for that.

name: Department Manager
rulesText: Promotion 1 — Office. Other Office Staff Employees you control get +1 Power if you played a Meeting card this turn.
flavorText: Can we align on this first?

name: Operations Director
rulesText: Promotion 2 — Office. The first Meeting or Process Action you play each turn costs 1 less. The first time an opponent’s card is delayed each turn, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Let’s standardize the exception.

name: Approval Required
rulesText: When your opponent activates an Action with printed cost 2 or more, they may pay 1 Capacity. If they do not, delay that Action until the start of their next Main Phase.
flavorText: Pending one final approval.

name: Calendar Block
rulesText: Target 1 opposing Employee; it cannot attack during its controller’s next Battle Phase.
flavorText: I’m technically available after 16:30.

name: All Hands Meeting
rulesText: Target up to 3 Employees you control; they each get +1 Power until end of turn. If you control a Lead or Executive, one of them gets an additional +1 Power.
implementationNotes: Base group buff plus optional selected bonus target are implemented; BONUS must be among TARGETS.
flavorText: This could not have been an email. Apparently.

name: Please Find Attached
rulesText: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck. You may reveal a Meeting or Process card and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
flavorText: Please find attached. This time, actually attached.

name: Approval Workflow
rulesText: The first Office Action with printed cost 2 or more you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Only four more signatures.

name: Paper Trail
rulesText: The first time an Office Action is Archived after resolving each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and one on the bottom.
flavorText: For documentation purposes.

name: Meeting Overrun
rulesText: When your opponent plays their second Action in a turn, after it resolves they lose 1 available Capacity.
flavorText: We’re five minutes over. Again.

name: Pending Approval
rulesText: When your opponent activates a targeted Action or effect, delay it until the start of their next Main Phase. Its current targets remain if legal.
flavorText: Still with Legal.

name: Signed and Approved
rulesText: Target 1 Office Lead or Executive you played this turn; remove Onboarding from it. It may attack this turn.
flavorText: Approved. Please don’t change anything.

name: Receptionist
rulesText: The first time you play an Email or Meeting card each turn, look at the top card of your Deck. You may put it on the bottom.
flavorText: I can fit you in between two meetings.

name: Meeting Minutes
rulesText: Target 1 Office Meeting or Process Action in your Archive, except Meeting Minutes; shuffle it into your Deck, then draw 1 card.
flavorText: For anyone who was definitely listening.

name: Social Media Manager
rulesText: The first time you play your second Marketing Action each turn, draw 1 card, then Archive 1 card from your hand.
flavorText: Can we make this more thumb-stopping?

name: Content Manager
rulesText: The first Content Action you play each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and the other on the bottom.
flavorText: I changed the headline. Again.

name: Performance Marketer
rulesText: The first time your opponent loses Reputation from a Marketing card effect each turn, they lose 1 additional Reputation.
flavorText: What’s the conversion rate?

name: PR Manager
rulesText: The first time you would lose Reputation from an opponent’s card effect each turn, reduce that loss by 1. This does not reduce battle damage.
implementationNotes: First opponent card-effect Reputation loss each turn is reduced by 1; battle damage is unaffected.
flavorText: Off the record, this is on the record.

name: Campaign Manager
rulesText: The first Campaign Action you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Is the tracking live?

name: Marketing Lead
rulesText: Promotion 1 — Marketing. The first time you play your second Marketing Action each turn, other Marketing Staff Employees you control get +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Can we make it pop, but strategic?

name: Chief Marketing Officer
rulesText: Promotion 2 — Marketing. The first Campaign Action you play each turn costs 1 less. The first time you play your third Marketing Action in a turn, your opponent loses 1 Reputation.
flavorText: What’s the big idea?

name: Last-Minute Briefing
rulesText: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck. You may reveal a Campaign or Content card and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
flavorText: Launch is tomorrow. Quick one.

name: Make It Pop
rulesText: Target 1 Marketing Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until end of turn. If this is your second Marketing Action this turn, it gets +2 instead.
flavorText: More energy. Less explanation.

name: Boost the Post
rulesText: Target 1 Marketing Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until end of turn. If it deals direct Reputation damage this turn, your opponent loses 1 additional Reputation.
implementationNotes: Power buff and additional Reputation loss after direct damage are implemented.
flavorText: Organic is doing great. Now put budget behind it.

name: One More Feedback Round
rulesText: Target 1 Marketing Action in your Archive, except One More Feedback Round; return it to your hand. You cannot play it this turn.
flavorText: Final_final_v7.

name: Going Viral
rulesText: Your opponent loses 2 Reputation. If this is your third Marketing Action this turn, they lose 2 additional Reputation.
flavorText: The comments are moving faster than approvals.

name: Client Feedback
rulesText: When a Marketing Action would be Archived after resolving, return it to your hand instead. You cannot play it again this turn.
implementationNotes: Uses the generic post-resolution Action archive replacement window.
flavorText: Love it! Just one tiny thing…

name: Content Calendar
rulesText: The first Content Action you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Scheduled until someone changes the plan.

name: Campaign Dashboard
rulesText: The first time you play a Content Action each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. You may reveal a Campaign Action and add it to your hand. Put the remaining cards on the bottom.
flavorText: Green means good. Mostly.

name: Damage Control
rulesText: When a Marketing Employee you control would be destroyed by battle, target 1 Campaign or Content Action in your Archive; return it to your hand.
flavorText: The statement is already drafted.

name: Creative Sync
rulesText: The first time you play a Campaign Action each turn while you have played a Content card this turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and one on the bottom.
flavorText: Five minutes to align before we align.

name: Production Worker
flavorText: Which line am I on today?

name: Temporary Worker
rulesText: When this Employee is Archived by your own Shift card effect, draw 1 card.
flavorText: I’m only here for the week.
implementationNotes: Self-archive trigger uses archive cause metadata and only fires for own SHIFT card effects.

name: Machine Operator
rulesText: While you control a Machine System, this gets +1 Power during your Battle Phase.
flavorText: It’s been making that noise all week.

name: Warehouse Worker
rulesText: While you control another Production Staff Employee, this gains +1 Power during your Battle Phase.
flavorText: It was definitely here yesterday.

name: Production Planner
rulesText: The first Output or Shift Action you play each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and one on the bottom.
flavorText: According to the plan, we’re ahead.

name: Maintenance Technician
rulesText: Once per turn, when a Production Machine System you control would be destroyed by an opponent’s card effect, you may Archive this Employee instead.
flavorText: Just keep it running.
implementationNotes: Archives itself and protects one targeted Production Machine System from the triggering destruction.

name: Shift Lead
rulesText: Promotion 1 — Production. During your Battle Phase, other Production Staff Employees you control get +1 Power while you control at least 3 Production Employees.
flavorText: Nobody leaves until the target is met.

name: Plant Manager
rulesText: Promotion 2 — Production. Other Production Employees you control get +1 Power during your Battle Phase. The first Production Employee you control that destroys an opposing Employee by battle each turn deals Breakthrough damage for that battle.
flavorText: I want full output.

name: Full Production
rulesText: Production Employees you control get +1 Power until end of turn. If you control at least 4 Production Employees when this resolves, they also gain Breakthrough until end of turn.
flavorText: Every line. Full speed.

name: Night Shift
rulesText: Production Employees you control that did not enter the field this turn get +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Same targets. Fewer people.

name: Overtime
rulesText: Target 1 Production Staff Employee you control; it may attack one additional time this turn. If it attacks twice this turn, Archive it during your End Phase.
flavorText: Just one more hour.

name: Cover the Shift
rulesText: When a Production Staff Employee you control is destroyed by battle, play a Production Staff Employee with printed cost 1 from your hand without paying its Capacity cost. It enters Onboarding.
implementationNotes: Post-battle Incident response plays a cost-1 Production Staff from hand for free in Onboarding.
flavorText: Can you come in? It’s urgent.

name: Assembly Line
rulesText: During your Battle Phase, Production Staff Employees you control get +1 Power while you control at least 3 Production Staff Employees.
flavorText: Keep it moving.

name: Conveyor Belt
rulesText: The first Production Staff Employee you play each turn gets +1 Power until the start of your next turn.
flavorText: No bottlenecks. In theory.

name: Packaging Machine
rulesText: The first time a Production Employee you control destroys an opposing Employee by battle each turn, target another Production Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: If it fits, it ships.

name: Emergency Shutdown
rulesText: When an opponent’s targeted Action or effect targets a Production Machine System you control, return that System to your hand.
flavorText: Nobody touch anything until Maintenance gets here.

name: Quality Hold
rulesText: Target 1 Production Staff Employee you control; Archive it, then draw 2 cards.
flavorText: Production is paused pending inspection.

name: Intern
flavorText: Happy to help. What does this button do?

name: Office Assistant
rulesText: The first time you play an Email or Analog card each turn, look at the top card of your Deck. You may put it on the bottom.
flavorText: I’ve already printed it for you.

name: Project Manager
rulesText: The first Meeting Action you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Let’s put a quick meeting…

name: Interim Team Lead
rulesText: Promotion 1 — any Employee. Once per turn, when your Action targets another Employee you control, that Employee gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Just until we find a permanent solution.
implementationNotes: Promotion plus once-per-turn response to your Action targeting another own Employee are implemented.

name: Presentation
rulesText: Target 1 Employee you control; it gets +2 Power until end of turn. If it is a Lead or Executive, restore 1 Reputation.
flavorText: I made a few slides.

name: Forgot My Lunch
rulesText: Target 1 opposing Employee; it gets -1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: I thought someone was ordering.

name: Order Takeout
rulesText: Target up to 2 Employees you control; they each get +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Put me down for the usual.

name: Office Gossip
rulesText: Reveal 1 random card from your opponent’s hand. If it is an Incident, you may look at all of their face-down Incidents until end of turn.
flavorText: Apparently, we’re not supposed to know this yet.
implementationNotes: Random hand reveal and temporary face-down Incident visibility are implemented server-side with viewer-safe projection.

name: Coffee Chat
rulesText: Both players draw 1 card. Target 1 Employee you control; it gets +1 Power until end of turn.
flavorText: Do you have five minutes?

name: Quick Meeting
rulesText: Target 2 Employees you control. Choose one; it gets +1 Power until end of turn. The other cannot attack this turn.
flavorText: This should only take ten minutes.
implementationNotes: Two targets are chosen; exactly one receives +1 Power and the other cannot attack this turn.

name: Sick Leave
rulesText: When an Employee you control would be destroyed by battle, return it to your hand instead.
flavorText: I’m not coming in tomorrow.

name: Coffee Machine
rulesText: The first Coffee card you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Business-critical infrastructure.

name: Spreadsheet
rulesText: Once per turn during your Main Phase, look at the top 2 cards of your Deck. Put one on top and the other on the bottom.
flavorText: There’s a tab for that.

name: Shared Inbox
rulesText: The first Email Action you play each turn costs 1 less.
flavorText: Someone has to own the inbox. Apparently.
